title: ophioglossum latifolium
intro: Ophioglossum latifolium, commonly known as the broad-leaved adder's tongue, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ophioglossum latifolium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
